Variants.Content: The Frega family belonged to the local elite of Braavos. As for its unique history, which is not widely spread, it is certain that the family lives in a republic composed of waterways, islands, merchant ships and workshops, rather than a kingdom relying on rural fiefdoms. Frega's wealth, whether derived from shipping, property, or trade, had to be protected through deeds, partnerships, and city courts. The status of a family will change with the ups and downs of politics and the market. Only prudent management and a trustworthy reputation can span several generations.

Braavos Houses of the same rank look at Frega, focusing on the marriage agreement, ship shares and whether it keeps its promises in disputes. No one will lend a large sum of money just because of a vague ancestral story. Realistic credit is the genealogy of the republic.

Boatmen and vendors along the waterways only spoke of Frega when they affected rents, wages, or dock rules. If a prominent family allows ordinary people to benefit from their prosperity, their reputation will not be confined to the aristocratic drawing rooms.

Entry Fregar Frega is a local house of Braavos with identifiable roots in urban trade, kinship networks, and long-term credit in a waterway society. The family crest is just a facade, the real weight of the family is whether they can protect their fiefdom, honor their engagements, and rally people in times of crisis.
